message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) from list.

Facts: theft of oil (原油) from pipeline, using vehicle, etc. This is theft of property (盗窃). Also there was arson (fire) caused by their actions: they set fire? It says during extraction, fire occurred and they burned vehicle, transformer, etc. The fire was accidental? It says "发生着火，并将面包车、1617号变压器、配电房内的电表及电线等烧毁". They caused fire while extracting oil. Could be "放火" (arson) or "过失以危险方法危害公共安全" (negligent dangerous method causing public safety). But they intentionally used heating device and caused fire. Might be "放火" (arson) as they set fire intentionally? The description: "在向车内抽送原油时发生着火，并将面包车、1617号变压器、配电房内的电表及电线等烧毁。" It doesn't say they intentionally set fire, just that fire occurred. Could be "过失以危险方法危害公共安全" if they used dangerous method (heating device) leading to fire. However typical Chinese law: "放火" is intentional arson. If they intentionally set fire, they'd be charged with "放火". If accidental, maybe "过失以危险方法危害公共安全". The fact says they installed heating device and used electric pump, causing fire. Might be considered "过失以危险方法危害公共安全". But many examples: In earlier case with oil theft and fire, they used heating device and fire occurred; they were charged with "放火"? Let's see similar example: earlier example with "失火" (fire) for farmer using welding causing fire. That was "失火". "失火" is accidental fire. "放火" is intentional. Here they used heating device to melt oil? Might be accidental. The list includes both "失火" and "放火". Which is appropriate? The description: "在向车内抽送原油时发生着火，并将面包车、1617号变压器、配电房内的电表及电线等烧毁。" It doesn't say they set fire deliberately. So likely "失火". However they used heating device, maybe they intentionally heated to melt oil, causing fire. Could be considered "放火" if they intentionally set fire to cover theft? Not clear.

The main crime is theft of oil: "盗窃". Also maybe "放火" or "失火". The list includes "失火". In earlier example, they used welding causing fire, they were charged with "失火". So similar accidental fire due to negligence. So we choose "盗窃;失火". Also maybe "非法占有" is part of theft but not separate. So answer: [罪名]盗窃;失火<eoa>
